35.sql:

    FROM (

40.sql:

43.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT cds, `AvgScrMath`, `AvgScrRead`, `AvgScrWrite`
    FROM satscores
),
c_agg AS (
    SELECT cds, `AvgScrMath` + `AvgScrRead` + `AvgScrWrite` AS total_score
    FROM c_cols
    GROUP BY cds
),
c_agg_filtered AS (
    SELECT cds, total_score
    FROM c_agg
    WHERE total_score IS NOT NULL
),
c_join AS (
    SELECT c.cds, c.total_score, s.`County`, ss.`AvgScrMath`
    FROM c_agg_filtered c
    JOIN schools s ON c.cds = s.`CDSCode`
    JOIN satscores ss ON c.cds = ss.cds
),
c_min AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM c_join
    WHERE total_score = (SELECT MIN(total_score) FROM c_join)
)
SELECT `AvgScrMath`, `County` FROM c_min;

    FROM client

189.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id, d.A11
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
c_age AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, district_id, A11, 
           (julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 AS age
    FROM c_cols
),
c_max_age AS (
    SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, district_id, A11, age
    FROM c_age
    WHERE age = (SELECT MAX(age) FROM c_age)
),
c_min_a11 AS (
    SELECT client_id, A11
    FROM c_max_age
    WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM c_max_age)
)
SELECT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN c_min_a11 m ON d.client_id = m.client_id;

231.sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY bond_type
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(count) AS max_count
    FROM bond_counts
),
majority_bond AS (
    SELECT bond_type
    FROM bond_counts
    WHERE count = (SELECT max_count FROM max_count)
)
SELECT mb.bond_type, m.label
FROM majority_bond mb
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR010';

    SELECT c.originalReleaseDate, l.format
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid

520.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT artist, uuid
    FROM cards
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT c.artist, l.format
    FROM c_cols c
    INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
),
c_agg AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM t_join
    GROUP BY artist
),
c_min AS (
    SELECT artist, card_count
    FROM c_agg
    WHERE card_count = (SELECT MIN(card_count) FROM c_agg)
)
SELECT t.artist, t.format
FROM t_join t
JOIN c_min cm ON t.artist = cm.artist
ORDER BY t.format;
